recent.statement: A tropical cyclone will make landfall in Central America within the next week
recent.evidence: No signal shows a tropical cyclone making landfall in Central America; the listed cyclones are in the South China Sea, eastern Pacific, and Texas.

recent.statement: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake will strike off the coast of Mexico
recent.evidence: No signal shows a magnitude 6.0 earthquake striking off the coast of Mexico during the window, and such an event would certainly have been captured.

recent.statement: Kerch Strait ship transits will drop below 1 daily transit due to intensified Russian-Ukrainian naval clashes
recent.evidence: Kerch Strait shows 2 daily transits, which is not below the forecast threshold of 1 daily transit.

recent.statement: A major wildfire will break out in California due to hot and dry conditions
recent.evidence: No captured signal documents any major California wildfire during the window, though such an event would certainly have been recorded.

recent.statement: A Category 2 hurricane will make landfall in the Gulf of Mexico
recent.evidence: The only Gulf of Mexico system, Bertha, is a Tropical Storm with zero population affected—far below Category 2 hurricane landfall—and no signal shows any such landfall.

recent.statement: Kerch Strait ship transits will drop below 1 per day due to intensified Russian-Ukrainian missile exchanges
recent.evidence: Kerch Strait shows 2 daily transits, which is above the forecast threshold of below 1 per day, so the predicted drop did not occur.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience a major oil tanker disruption due to Iranian naval activity
recent.evidence: No signal reports Iranian naval activity or a major tanker disruption; S10 only shows Hormuz transits 30% below average, a routine status condition that does not evidence the forecast event.

recent.statement: The US will experience significant market volatility due to rising tensions with Iran
recent.evidence: Nasdaq 100 futures fell only 1.18% with no signal indicating significant volatility or Iran-related tensions, so the forecast event was not captured.

recent.statement: A severe thunderstorm warning will be issued for the Buffalo, NY area within the next week.
recent.evidence: No captured signal concerns this forecast, and a severe thunderstorm warning for Buffalo would certainly have been captured if issued during the closed window.

recent.statement: The price of oil will rise by at least $5 per barrel within the next week due to supply chain disruptions.
recent.evidence: Brent Crude is at 96.78 $/bbl down 3.88%, showing oil fell rather than rising by at least $5 per barrel.

recent.statement: Kerch Strait ship transits will drop below 1 daily due to intensified Ukrainian conflict near the strait.
recent.evidence: Kerch Strait shows 2 daily transits, which is not below the forecast threshold of 1 daily.

recent.statement: A tropical cyclone will make landfall in Vietnam, causing widespread flooding.
recent.evidence: No signal shows a tropical cyclone making landfall in Vietnam; NOUL-26 is located at 21.8,115.9 (South China Sea near China) with no landfall or flooding in Vietnam indicated.

self_calibration.note: Published headline probability is RAW conviction (unchanged); this is the honest companion. Calibration fixes overconfidence, not discrimination — see /calibration.
